title: The Dinosaur Shirt
can_do: 用颜色或明显特征说清楚自己要哪一个。
trigger: Dad offers two shirts, but there are two red shirts and he needs one more detail.
stretch_response: I want the red one with the dinosaur.
repair_response: No, the one with the dinosaur.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: It is time to get dressed. The red shirt or the blue shirt?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can I have the red one, please?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: No, I want the red one with the dinosaur.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: The dinosaur shirt. I found it.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes, that is the one I want. Thanks, Dad!

parent_support: Start with a broad choice, then ask for one useful detail.
Accept any visible detail that truly identifies the object.
